question: To which class of agents must the intended meaning of the preceding question be restricted if the rejection is not attributed to a wise one?
premises: A rejection of the pure paths has been posed as a question.
That rejection is not attributed to a wise one.
A restricted class of agents is offered as the intended referent.
inference: The intended meaning is that only evil-minded ones would hold such a rejection.
uncertainties: The scope of 'thus' depends entirely on the argument of verse 208.
plain_english: The meaning is this: it is indeed evil-minded ones alone.
